translations.web: in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot dappled horses, all of them powerful.
translations.bsb: the third white horses, and the fourth dappled horses—all of them strong.
translations.kjv: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
translations.asv: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grizzled strong horses.
